# LEXYGO Material Handling Equipment

> Zhejiang Changxing Shengli Intelligent Machinery Co., Ltd. supplies electric pallet trucks, stackers, electric forklifts, manual pallet trucks, and warehouse equipment.

## Product families
- [Electric Pallet Trucks](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/electric-pallet-trucks/): Move palletized loads efficiently across warehouses, docks, and mixed surfaces.
- [Electric Pallet Stackers](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/electric-pallet-stackers/): Lift, place, and retrieve pallets in low- to medium-height storage areas.
- [Electric Forklifts](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/electric-forklifts/): Electric counterbalanced forklifts for indoor logistics and industrial handling.
- [Manual Pallet Trucks](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/manual-pallet-trucks/): Simple, dependable pallet movement and manual high-lift handling.
- [Warehouse Equipment](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/warehouse-equipment/): Compact lifting tables, platform trucks, and support equipment for material flow.

## Buyer resources
- [Resource Center](https://www.lexygolift.com/resources/): Product selection, compliance, documents, FAQs, and applications.
- [Compliance Center](https://www.lexygolift.com/resources/compliance/): Model-specific document verification guidance.
- [Downloads and Documents](https://www.lexygolift.com/resources/download/): Product data and controlled document requests.
- [Buyer FAQ](https://www.lexygolift.com/resources/faq/): Direct answers for professional buyers.
- [How to Choose an Electric Pallet Truck](https://www.lexygolift.com/guides/how-to-choose-an-electric-pallet-truck/): A practical checklist for load, route length, floor condition, turning space, battery, and duty cycle.
- [Pallet Truck vs. Pallet Stacker](https://www.lexygolift.com/guides/pallet-truck-vs-stacker/): Use a pallet truck to move loads horizontally and a stacker when the task includes lifting into storage positions.
- [Forklift Capacity, Lift Height, and Aisle Width](https://www.lexygolift.com/guides/forklift-capacity-and-aisle-width/): Why rated capacity alone is not enough when selecting an electric forklift.
